arguments.message:
Yes – you can set up an automatic weekly export to a cloud‑storage destination.

1. Go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**.
2. Click **Add new schedule**, pick the data you want to export and set the recurrence to **weekly**.
3. Connect your cloud‑storage account (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.) via the one‑time OAuth connection.
4. Save the schedule.

Each weekly run will create a new file in the connected storage, and the Scheduled exports screen will show a history of the runs and their status.
